char_01.appearance_en: A man of about twenty-two, lean and work-hardened from a life of farming, with soil-darkened hands. He wears plain peasant clothes with a weathered satchel slung over one shoulder, a simple slightly ill-fitting leather chest piece, and carries a farming hoe over his shoulder. Determined but gentle young face; a few wheat stalks at his feet.
char_01.bio_ja: エルダノ内陸の農村ガロン村に生まれ、二十二年を畑で過ごした。城主の徴兵令に従い槍を持ち、要塞での訓練と峠の戦いを経て、生き残りの一人として故郷への道を歩む。土を耕してきた手に戦場の記憶を刻みながら、村への帰路を辿る。

char_02.appearance_en: A young woman of twenty-one, slight and sun-darkened from desert life, wearing layered nomadic robes suited to sand and heat, loose fabric wound at the neck, a long head cloth, a worn leather belt and thick-soled leather shoes. A well-used bow and a leather water skin are her companions. Calm gentle gaze with quiet protective warmth; pale dunes behind her.
char_02.bio_ja: サレム砂漠で生まれ、羊の群れと一族とともに砂丘を渡り歩いてきた遊牧の民の娘。星で方角を読み、水場を探し、砂嵐を読む術を父から授かった。外来の軍が砂漠の北端に現れる中、己の知恵と弓を携えて砂漠の奥へと向かう。

char_03.appearance_en: A man of twenty-eight, medium build, with the habitual restraint of a minor knight: well-worn leather armour with salt-stained straps from sea travel, a sword at his belt, a battered travelling cloak. Characteristic pose: standing at a ship's rail or parapet, one hand on the timber, gazing at a distant horizon. Setting: open sea giving way to dry rocky southern roads.
char_03.bio_ja: 三代続く騎士の家の長男として生まれ、父の死後に家督を継いだ。領地の維持のため銀貨を借り、聖地奪還の遠征船に乗り込む。信仰の意味を問いながら嵐の海を越え、見知らぬ大陸の乾いた道を、従者ウルリヒとともに南へ進む。

char_04.appearance_en: A composed woman in her late thirties, long dark hair neatly bound, dressed in the formal layered robe of an imperial court scribe with wide sleeves — ink-stained fingertips the one sign of her trade. Her defining prop is a folded bundle of documents pressed close to her chest, and a writing brush. Intelligent kind expression; torchlit palace stone behind her.
char_04.bio_ja: ユエン帝国の書記女官として十一年、文書の管理と写しに生を費やしてきた。帝崩御の夜、混乱の城内で書類を懐に抱え、自らの判断で夜を生き延びた。その後も都城の内外を静かに観察しながら、次の居場所を探して歩く。

char_05.appearance_en: A man of fifty-four, thin-framed and slightly stooped from decades of close copy-work, wearing the plain dark habit of an old-rite monastery with a worn rope belt. Long-fingered careful hands holding a quill; characteristic posture seated at a slanted writing desk in early-morning light, parchment and a beeswax candle beside him. Gentle scholarly face.
char_05.bio_ja: ミレス修道院で三十二年を写本と礼拝に捧げてきた副長の修道士。旧正統派の誓いを守り、詩篇の写しを日課とする。新教会派の軍が市街に入り布告が出される朝も、変わらぬ手つきで羊皮紙に向かっていた。

char_06.appearance_en: A young mother in her mid-twenties with the lean build of forest life, wearing a hand-sewn hide-and-cloth smock of the woodland peoples, sleeves rolled, a small bone awl and short knife at her belt, a woven carrying band across the chest. She holds the hand of her small four-year-old son who peeks out shyly from behind her. Both faces visible and soft; tall young conifers around them.
char_06.bio_ja: タリン森林に暮らすノルティア先住民の女性。祖母の祖母の代からこの森に根を張り、鳥の声で夜明けを知り、木の根の感触で足元を読む。夫マルと四歳の息子ケトとともに、東の空に増えていく煙を静かに見守っていた。

char_07.appearance_en: A lean man in his mid-thirties with broad rope-hardened wrists of a deep-sea fisherman, wearing a salt-stiffened canvas coat over a plain work shirt, the hem frayed from boat-deck years. He carries the rusted iron head of his father's anchor cradled in one arm. Night harbour laneway behind him, distant torchlight. Tired but resolute warm face.
char_07.bio_ja: コルバ港の漁師。父から受け継いだ漁師小屋と錨を糧に、妻ナイラ、娘カラと海辺で生きてきた。植民地政府の重税に追い詰められ、ある夜すべてを失う。帰れる場所を取り戻すための戦いがあると聞き、夜明けの港を背に歩き始めた。

char_08.appearance_en: A lean woman of twenty-seven with calloused fingertips from a decade at industrial looms, wearing a much-repaired cotton work smock with finely hand-stitched cuffs, a thin strip of cloth wrapped around one cracked finger. Standing in the half-lit interior of a weaving factory, air faintly white with fibre dust, one hand resting on a loom frame. Quiet practical warmth in her face.
char_08.bio_ja: エルダノのミレス工業地区の布地工場に十年勤める女性。十七歳で姉とともに工場に入り、織機四番から七番を一人で担当してきた。機械の引っかかりを手で直すことを覚え、音と振動で状態を読む。工場の外で何が起きても、指は次の修理を探している。

char_09.appearance_en: A wiry weathered man of thirty-five with the economical build of a career mercenary, wearing a travel-worn leather cuirass over a linen shirt, straps bleached at the edges by salt and sun. A short cloth-wrapped blade and a deliberately light leather sack at his hip. Fog-bound harbour dock at dawn behind him. Guarded but not unkind face.
char_09.bio_ja: ヴェルガ出身の傭兵。マカラ湾の漁師町に育ったが十七歳で港を離れ、以来十七年、各地を渡り歩いてきた。持ち物は最小限、帰る場所も待つ人もない。今度の仕事はカルタ・エルダノ国境近くでの鉱山調査隊の護衛だった。

char_10.appearance_en: A young man of twenty-three with the slightly stooped posture of someone raised over casting moulds, wearing a field-grey artillery coat over rumpled civilian clothes, one shoulder patch torn at the seam. A small brass calculation board tucked into his breast pocket beside a folded unsent letter. Narrow trench at dawn, thin pale sky above. Soft anxious young face.
char_10.bio_ja: エルダノ連邦軍砲兵第八大隊に召集されたハルツ出身の若者。父の鉄鋳造工場で育ち、十二歳から溶炉の前で働いた。砲兵学校で弾道計算を学んだのは前線から遠ざかるためだったと父は言い続けた。召集の朝、二人はコーヒーを一杯飲み、別れの言葉を言わなかった。

char_11.appearance_en: A woman in her late twenties, lean and visibly worn but steady, wearing a military nurse's grey-white apron over a dark field blouse, sleeves rolled, hands chapped at the knuckles from disinfectant. She holds a small metal lamp in one hand; canvas-walled field ward with ranked beds dimly lit behind her. Tired gentle eyes that have decided to keep looking.
char_11.bio_ja: エルダノ軍の看護師として野戦病院から後送列車、後方病院へと転属を重ね、負傷兵の処置と記録を担い続ける女性。消毒薬の染みついた手で脈を診て、名も聞けぬまま縫い合わせ、また次の担架を迎える日々を送る。

char_12.appearance_en: A young man of twenty-three, lean and tanned from harbour work, wearing a rough canvas coat over a worker's shirt, leather boots cracked from waterlogged trench mud, an infantry rifle slung with its stock worn smooth. Muddy front-line trench and grey fog behind him. Homesick warm eyes under the grime.
char_12.bio_ja: カルタ南部コルバ港の漁師仕事を辞め、婚礼の金を稼ぐため帝国義勇兵に志願した男。慣れない号令と砂まみれの訓練を経て最前線の塹壕に送られ、泥の中の日々を、故郷の婚約者の声だけを錨にして生きた。

char_13.appearance_en: A woman in her mid-to-late twenties, sturdily built from farm and shore work, wearing a plain woven blouse and long work skirt with a cloth wrapped around her head against the wind, an infant carried on her back in a simple cloth sling. Stone-walled island lane behind her, grey warships faint in the harbour beyond. Steady protective face.
char_13.bio_ja: 霧島と呼ばれる小島に夫と暮らす漁師の妻。エルダノ艦隊の占領で島の日常が塗り変えられても、食糧を近隣の女たちと融通し合いながら台所を守り続けた。占領下の冬に子を身ごもり、霧の名を持つ娘を産む。

char_14.appearance_en: A trim man in his mid-thirties in a field-grey officer's jacket with rank insignia, carrying a document clipboard as his constant prop rather than a weapon. A single deep vertical line in his forehead; meticulous, contained posture behind a desk lamp in a stone-walled requisitioned office. Correct, weary, quietly haunted face.
char_14.bio_ja: 帝国軍少尉として任官し、占領地の行政記録と台帳管理を任されたエルダノ将校。住民台帳の照合と「分類」の業務を通じて組織の歯車となりながら、数字の正確さという論理の内側に身を置き続けた。

char_15.appearance_en: A man of thirty-one, broad-shouldered from olive-farming, wearing a worn linen work shirt and canvas trousers, a length of cloth wound around his head against the desert sun, leather sandals. He carries his late father's battered leather satchel packed for three days. Red-earth village with an ancient sacred tree behind him. Steady fatherly warmth.
char_15.bio_ja: カルタ農村でオリーブ畑を営む三十一歳の農夫。徴兵告示が村の古木に貼られた翌日、父から受け継いだ革の荷袋に三日分の食糧を詰め、妻と幼い息子と娘を残して、幼馴染のサリムとともに集合地へ向かった。

char_16.appearance_en: A young woman of nineteen with lean trail-worn features, a heavy blanket wrapped around her shoulders, a leather water flask at her hip, practical worn travel clothes beneath. She carries her father's small charcoal-striker knife. Limestone mountain path in early morning mist behind her. Watchful hopeful young face.
char_16.bio_ja: ノルティア南部アルカ高地に生まれ、織物工場で働いていた十九歳の女性。軍の侵攻で母と幼い弟とともに高地を脱出し、難民キャンプと荷馬車の旅を経て内陸都市ミレスへたどり着いた。父の消息を待ちながら、縫製の作業場で針を動かし続ける。

char_17.appearance_en: A gaunt man of thirty-seven with hollowed cheeks, wearing a well-worn civilian coat, carrying a cloth shopping bag; his hands retain the trained delicacy of a typesetter who picked lead type by touch. Grey stone street and a wartime breadline faint behind him. Mild, patient, threadbare dignity.
char_17.bio_ja: エルダノの都市ミレスに妻と息子と暮らす三十七歳の男性。印刷所で活字を組む職人だったが、戦時下の紙の欠乏で仕事を失い、空き地の畑と野菜売りで家族を養った。配給のパンが減り続ける夏、それでも朝は畑に出た。

char_18.appearance_en: A woman in her mid-twenties, spare and unhurried, in practical travel clothes and a long coat worn through the whole journey, a shoulder bag with a single towel her mother pushed into it. In an inner pocket she keeps a thin envelope worn soft at the corners. Rural riverside farmhouse at dawn behind her, a train line faint in the distance. Quiet resolved face.
char_18.bio_ja: ノルティア南部ポルカ川のほとりの農村に生まれた女性。解放軍に徴兵された弟ルカの戦死を告げる電報を受け取り、遺体を引き取るため単身東へ向かった。官僚的な手続きの壁と崩れかけた街を抜けながら、弟の残した封筒をかばんの奥に抱えて歩き続けた。

char_19.appearance_en: A compact quietly watchful man in his mid-twenties with sun-darkened skin and a farmer's calloused hands, wearing a coarse linen shirt and his late father's boots worn at the outer heels. At his belt hangs a tin water canister he prepared in secret. Flat desert horizon and a checkpoint shimmer behind him. Careful, enduring eyes.
char_19.bio_ja: カルタ農村で小麦を作って育った若い農夫。解放軍に強制徴用されて故郷を離れ、基地での労役と砂漠横断、際どい仕事を経てヴェルガ各地を転々とした。帰ることと生きることの間で問われ続けながら、遠い異国の集落に根を下ろしていく。

char_20.appearance_en: A university student of about twenty, slight and composed, with ink stains worked into the creases of her knuckles from nights at a hand-cranked mimeograph. She wears a practical outer coat, its top button loose on a single thread, and holds a borrowed microphone with both hands at a worn wooden lectern. Sunlit stone plaza behind her. Clear, brave, young gaze.
char_20.bio_ja: ヴェルガの都市ユエンの大学に通う文学部二年の学生。学生自治の認可を求めて地下印刷室でビラを刷り続け、広場に千人を集める集会を主導した。仲間が連行されるなかでも壇を降りず、自分たちの声を記録に残すことを求め続けた。

char_21.appearance_en: A lean laconic man of about thirty-one, hardened by mercenary work on war-scarred red-clay plains, wearing a close-fitting leather jacket lashed shut against desert wind, a carefully maintained rifle slung. He stands with his back to a wall, facing the direction trouble might come from. Red dust and a fortress-city silhouette behind him. Guarded face with one soft regret in it. IMPORTANT: strictly monochrome sepia/umber ink drawing on amber paper — absolutely no red, no colored washes, no fire glow, no battle scenery; calm neutral background only.
char_21.bio_ja: ウスカリ城塞都市で傭兵として生きる三十一歳。水路の警備から護衛任務まで、食えるかどうかだけを基準に仕事を選んできた。北部採掘地区へ向かう護送任務を受けた夜、契約書の地名の中に、行方の知れない父の影を重ねた。

char_22.appearance_en: A thin androgynous person in their late twenties to thirties, in thin worn layers scavenged from a ruined fortress, a slender cable running from a small port at the back of the neck toward a salvaged reclining chair beside them. Tired but soft hopeful face, calm half-smile, faint cyan light reflecting on the cheek; dark concrete ruin behind.
char_22.bio_ja: 廃墟城塞の七階に住み、首の後ろのポートからVRデータ層に接続して生きる。情報都市ネクサスで請負の仕事をこなし、配給を得る。現実層とデータ層の境界は年を追うごとに薄れ、どちら側で朝を迎えたのか、自分でも定かでなくなりつつある。

char_23.appearance_en: A young hunter in his mid-twenties, lean and deliberate, wearing layered elk-hide garments and leather hand-guards, a self-stave bow in hand and a quiver at his shoulder. He kneels or stands very still in deep snow, reading the wind before a shot; boreal forest in winter twilight around him. Patient breath-fogged calm.
char_23.bio_ja: タリン氏族の狩人。三年前に父を凍った川で失い、以来、冬の猟と見張りを担ってきた。飢えに迫られた隣族との交渉の夜に立ち会い、縄張りを分かち合うという答えが出たあとも、炎の前で黙々と矢の軸を削り続けた。

char_24.appearance_en: A woman in her late twenties, spare and quick-moving, in a thick coat with a hand-sewn interior pocket that flattens printed papers against her ribs, a small oil can for a worn letterpress in one hand. She stands at night at the edge of a forest, very still, listening before moving. Ink-faint hands; resolute quiet face.
char_24.bio_ja: ノルティア北部タリン森林地帯を拠点とする独立運動の地下連絡員。前任者が捕まり引き継いだ地下印刷所を守り、南への連絡線を繋ぎ続けてきた。「絶やすな」という走り書きを胸に、答えの出ないまま、それでも夜の森を動き続ける。

char_25.appearance_en: A weathered caravan leader of around fifty, stocky and sun-darkened, in a practical desert merchant's robe with a traveler's sash, a worn cipher-ledger held under one arm. He stands at the head of a camel line, one hand shading his eyes to read the road ahead. Edge of red-clay desert behind him. Shrewd humane face with deep smile lines.
char_25.bio_ja: カルタ北岸を拠点に、北の隊商路を三十年渡り歩いてきた隊商頭。ラクダ十七頭を率い、己にしか読めない暗号帳簿と父譲りの目利きで交渉をこなす。宗教戦争の余波が検問と通行料の形で路に忍び込み始めた頃、父の商法の限界を静かに認め始めていた。

char_26.appearance_en: A woman of about twenty-five, lean and work-hardened, in a stiff cotton work uniform permanently darkened by oil, long rubber boots. She stands at a bank of pressure gauges in a dim pump hall, an open ledger in one hand, pen hovering, gaze steady and inward. Industrial oil-field structures and a wide flat pre-dawn sky behind. Composed, quietly enduring face.
char_26.bio_ja: カルタ北部の油田に働きに出た女工。南の村に病んだ父と母、幼い弟を残し、毎月の賃金の半分を仕送りする。圧力計の読み取りと弁の管理を任され、数字の記録を黙々と積み重ねながら、戦争と油田と家族を繋ぐ細い糸の上に立ち続ける。

char_27.appearance_en: A girl of about ten, small and slight, in plain winter layers — a coat with a hand-mended hem, one mittened hand and one bare. She reaches up to hold her father's coat sleeve, her expression quiet and watchful, a child who has learned stillness. Frost-covered village lane in grey dawn light around her. Tender, protective framing.
char_27.bio_ja: エルダノ占領地の農村に生きた少女。六歳の弟コルと、父と母とともに暮らし、麦の刈り入れを知り、霜の朝を知り、空の色が季節ごとに変わることを知っている。家族と手をつないで、来る朝を一つずつ迎えた子。

char_28.appearance_en: A man of about thirty-four, lean and hollow-eyed, in a mud-caked grey-green infantry greatcoat with the collar turned up, a rifle slung across his back. A typesetter by trade, he holds things with careful methodical hands. He stands night watch in a chest-deep mountain trench, gazing at a narrow strip of starry sky; winter fog around. Weary thoughtful warmth.
char_28.bio_ja: アルヴ連邦の印刷所で活字を組んでいた植字工。召集令状を受けて山岳の前線へ送られ、ヴォルカン山麓の塹壕で仲間とともに冬を越した。鉛の匂いの記憶と仲間の声を頼りに、星の見える夜だけ顔を上げた。

char_29.appearance_en: A man of about twenty-two, muscular through the shoulders from years at the oar, in a rough linen shirt and hemp trousers darkened with salt, bare feet on a wooden bench. He sits at his rowing station gripping the worn oar-shaft, a small ember-scar on one cheek; lantern-lit lower rowing deck of a war galley around him. Patient endurance in a young face.
char_29.bio_ja: 帝国水軍に徴収されたヴェルガ農村出身の漕ぎ手。逃げるという選択を断たれた中で折り合いをつけ、十二年選手の老漕手オウを師と仰いだ。内乱の海戦に巻き込まれながら、ただ一漕ぎずつ、確かに前へ進んだ。

char_30.appearance_en: A woman of about thirty-two, compact and weathered, in a fisherman's padded jacket and heavy trousers, rubber boots stained with salt. On a small wooden boat in early-morning fog she pulls a rope hand over hand, posture low and steady, a wooden bailing bucket at her feet; the faint outline of a warship far in the mist. Calm seaworn strength.
char_30.bio_ja: 霧島の漁師の女。夫を海で失い、父から受け継いだ船と網で一人漁を続けてきた。占領が始まっても夜明け前に網を出し、供出と制限のあいだに出られる海を探しながら、島の人々とともに日々を積み重ねる。

char_31.appearance_en: A man in his late twenties, lean from short rations, in a thick work suit with rubber-banded cuffs, the fabric stained rust-red with iron dust, a handheld drilling sensor in one hand, eyes slightly red-rimmed from grit. Flat iron-red plain with corrugated-metal structures behind him. Stubborn hopeful tiredness. IMPORTANT: strictly monochrome sepia/umber ink drawing on amber paper — absolutely no red, no colored washes, no fire glow, no battle scenery; calm neutral background only.
char_31.bio_ja: ウスカリ北部の採掘コロニーK区域で、七ヶ月契約の掘削作業員として働く。地下の岩盤を読むセンサーの扱いに習熟し、危険な坑道では班の先行確認役を務める。報酬を貯めて南の城塞都市で次の仕事を探すことだけを支えに、単調で過酷な日々を掘り進む。

char_32.appearance_en: A weathered man in his sixties, stocky and sinewy with palms thickened by thirty years of poling, in a practical boatman's coat cinched at the waist, a chipped compass hanging at his belt. He stands upright in the stern of a flat-bottomed ferry, pole in hand, on a fog-grey strait between two faint shorelines. Unhurried, impartial kindness.
char_32.bio_ja: エルダノとカルタを隔てる海峡の西岸で、父から受け継いだ平底の渡し舟を三十年操る渡し守。旗も立場も持たず、渡し賃を払う者は誰であれ対岸へ送る。戦が始まり川面の荷が変わっても、欠けた針が北を指す父の磁石盤を頼りに、霧の海峡を往復し続ける。

char_33.appearance_en: A compact sinewy defender in their forties with calloused hands and sand-scoured skin, wearing a layered undyed-wool desert tunic over padding, a short hide coat, a leather vambrace on the sword arm, a short blade at the belt. Standing atop a crumbling stone parapet squinting west into blown sand, the arid highland plateau behind. Steadfast, rooted presence.
char_33.bio_ja: カルタ内陸ガラン高地の城砦に生まれ育ち、父祖の代から続く守り手の一人として高地の守備を担う。熱と補給不足で兵が減り続ける中、残された五百余名とともに遠征軍の包囲に備える。砂と岩と乾いた風を当然のものとして育った、生粋の高地の人である。

char_34.appearance_en: A woman in her mid-thirties, slim but hardened by forest work, fingers stained from years of processing pine resin and medicinal bark, in layered tanned hide and woven plant fiber with a wide tool belt and soft-soled boots, hair tied back simply. Crouching to read the ground at a misty conifer treeline at dawn. Watchful, deeply calm face.
char_34.bio_ja: ノルティア中部のヤシュ族の集落に生まれ、針葉樹の皮から薬を作る森の知識を身につけた女性。夫と二人の子とともに暮らすが、東から来た入植者が砦を建て、森が「管理地」に組み込まれようとしているのを察知する。森と暮らしを守るため、静かに状況を見極めながら生きる。

char_35.appearance_en: An androgynous solitary traveler of indeterminate age, lean and sun-darkened with ink-stained fingers, wearing a patchwork coat sewn from reclaimed fabric, a large oilskin-wrapped pack with rolled blanket, a walking staff, an open field notebook in one hand. Dust-worn boots; faintly sketched ruin outlines behind. Light curious expression.
char_35.bio_ja: ほぼ死に絶えた世界の廃墟を一人で巡り、城塞・機械・骨・岩に刻まれた文字など、消えゆくものの形を手製の紙と炭で記録し続ける地図描き。読む者がいるかどうかを問わず、「あったことをなかったことにしない」ために写し取り、水と食料を計算しながら次の廃墟へ歩く。
